name: deed.page
summary: Hosted remote MCP server and HTTP API that lets an agent publish HTML or static files to a permanent HTTPS URL at a slug it picks, without an account.
description: One `PUT` (or the `publish_site` MCP tool) returns a live URL at `https://{slug}.deed.page/` plus an owner token; the agent keeps the token to update, list, restore earlier versions of, or delete its sites. The remote Streamable HTTP endpoint is `https://deed.page/mcp`. An MIT-licensed agent skill and plugin repo covers Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. Paid plans add more sites, storage and custom domains.

agent_access.notes: No account needed to publish; the first publish returns an owner token. Send it as a Bearer token to update or delete that slug later.
